name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.CircuitSAT.leafCircuit_spec
title: Translate the registered CircuitSAT gate list into a leaf circuit with a gate-count noise bound
statement: Every nonempty CircuitSAT gate list gives a leaf circuit evaluating in any commutative ring to the bit of the registered Boolean evaluation on every assignment, with noise bounded by (W+1)^g E for g gates.
